part.text: {"scores": [{"programme": 1, "criterion": "fit", "value": 3, "reason": "Simulated peptide-domain pH proxy feeds receptor-mechanism step only through SPR and Transwell stand-ins, at a different scale."}, {"programme": 1, "criterion": "change", "value": 4, "reason": "Positive outcome would rank ~1,500 variants before SPR/Transwell, changing which pairs to express; negative outcome changes nothing."}, {"programme": 1, "criterion": "new", "value": 4, "reason": "Wet-lab pH-release and Transwell analogue exists for one pair, but no computed MD classifier across variants; partly answered."}, {"programme": 2, "criterion": "fit", "value": 3, "reason": "Card models LRP6/ALPL peptides in water; step validates orthologue binding and relies on in vivo screens, needing bridging."}, {"programme": 2, "criterion": "change", "value": 4, "reason": "A validated score would filter designs before 10^4-10^7 in vivo screens, but needs cell-level validation the card omits."}, {"programme": 2, "criterion": "new", "value": 5, "reason": "No public work shows pH-resolved MD classification of transcytosis versus retention; practice is in vivo screening plus orthologue binding."}, {"programme": 3, "criterion": "fit", "value": 4, "reason": "Card reproduces the lab's own AlphaFold-Multimer LRP6 check on identical peptide-domain systems, but substitutes MD for SPR confirmation."}, {"programme": 3, "criterion": "change", "value": 4, "reason": "Computed pH score would triage interactome hits before SPR and cryo-EM, though cell-level validation the card lacks remains required."}, {"programme": 3, "criterion": "new", "value": 4, "reason": "Lab already ran the check-first AlphaFold/SPR half, but has published no pH-resolved replica-MD classifier; partly answered."}]}
